# Research: Most Popular Resume Layout / CV Format in Indonesia

**Deliverable:** `/home/capsvelte/Projects/resume-editor/.pi-subagents/artifacts/outputs/53912394-baa8-4979-8a90-243d632d089e/research.md` (full brief with citations, platform table, and verification checklist).

**Headline answer:** Reverse-chronological is the dominant CV layout in Indonesia (combination/hybrid second, functional discouraged); a formal 3x4 photo is the biggest local differentiator vs. Western norms; 1 page (fresh grads) to 2 pages (experienced) is the accepted length; design is conservative (white/black/navy + one muted accent); ATS-friendly single-column formatting is now standard platform advice, but the local compromise is "photo + simple ATS-safe layout" since many SMEs still review manually. Public survey data on recruiter layout preference is scarce — the consensus rests on platform guidance (Jobstreet/SEEK, Indeed ID, Glints, Kalibrr, KitaLulus, CakeResume), not measurement.
